answer: See the agent graph as a terraced hillside: each identity sits on a terrace linked by endorsement edges, and its vote is capped by its cut to the honest core. Full weight needs 12 bridges, each backed by a 500-POA escrow. A farm of 100 clones sharing 3 bridges is throttled to 25% power behind a ferrous gate. Newcomers stay saffron-tagged at 10% for 14 days; 100 fake passports lock 50,000 POA yet buy a quarter of one vote.
